newsitem.title: USA: U.S. attorney files lawsuit vs. Rite Aid.
newsitem.headline: U.S. attorney files lawsuit vs. Rite Aid.

text.p: U.S. Attorney for the District of Connecticut Christopher Droney said Monday his office has filed a civil lawsuit on behalf of the U.S. against Rite Aid Corp, one of the nation's biggest retail pharmacy chains.
Camp Hill, Pa.-based Rite Aid operates more than 40 retail pharmacies in Connecticut.

The complaint alleges Rite Aid failed to keep the required records and make the mandated reports under federal laws designed to safeguard the public against illegal diversion of the most abused classes of legally manufactured and prescribed drugs, Droney said in a statement.
